Pose Landmarker Lite, float16, model version 1:
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_lite/float16/1/pose_landmarker_lite.task
Model documentation: https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/pose_landmarker

The app loads these assets from its own server. Camera frames are processed
in the browser worker and are not uploaded to Google or the app server.

Face Landmarker, float16, model version 1:
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task
Model documentation: https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/face_landmarker
Used for visible face position, measured oval, lip motion and observable blendshape actions; no psychological emotion inference.
R07 additionally enables the measured facial transformation matrix for a head-attached emoji.

Hand Landmarker, float16, model version 1:
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task
Model documentation: https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/hand_landmarker
SHA-256: fbc2a30080c3c557093b5ddfc334698132eb341044ccee322ccf8bcf3607cde1
Used in the same local worker with numHands: 2. The 21 measured landmarks per
hand remain in unmirrored camera coordinates until rendering. No camera upload.

BlazeFace Short Range, float16, model version 1:
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_detector/blaze_face_short_range/float16/1/blaze_face_short_range.tflite
Model documentation: https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/face_detector
SHA-256: b4578f35940bf5a1a655214a1cce5cab13eba73c1297cd78e1a04c2380b0152f
Used at low frequency only to pause attribution when more than one face is observed.

Selfie Segmenter Landscape, float16, model version 1:
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/image_segmenter/selfie_segmenter_landscape/float16/1/selfie_segmenter_landscape.tflite
Model documentation: https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/image_segmenter
The pinned model has one foreground confidence channel. The application reads
confidenceMasks[0], not category values (this model's category 0 denotes foreground
and 255 denotes background). Used as a full-frame foreground probability mask.
